Direct induction restricts to \(X\oplus\Theta(Y)\), hence its factor class is the least torsion class containing \(\mathcal U\) and \(\mathcal V\) whenever it is support \(	au\)-tilting. The two cross-membership conditions are the opposite inclusions \(\mathcal V\subseteq\mathcal U\) and \(\mathcal U\subseteq\mathcal V\). The semisimple \(M_2(k^n)\) count then reduces to union versus intersection of subsets. No hidden finite computation is needed.
